mechanism: Atazanavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) increases mefloquine plasma concentrations, elevating risk of neurotoxicity and cardiac arrhythmias; mefloquine may also inhibit atazanavir metabolism bidirectionally.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for mefloquine toxicity (neuropsychiatric effects, QT prolongation) and consider alternative antimalarial agents.
